ARCS kitMolecule 60heat-take

Heat Take

List the author's opinions from mild to loco, with the heat shown as a five-pip meter and a word, so the reader can tell a safe take from a provocative one without a colour ladder.

States

Anatomy

#PartType roleToken (CSS variable)
1RowOne take a row, hairlines between rows onlyborder
2HeatFive pips, filled to the level, then the word (Mild, Medium, Caliente, Fuego, Loco)text, text-secondary
3TakeOne or two sentences in the author's voicetext

Usage

Use it when

  • The author's own opinions, ranked by how far they push.
  • A recap where the reader wants the blunt version after the evidence.

Do not use it when

  • Do not colour the heat green to red: in ARCS green means proven and red means failed, and a take is neither.
  • Do not mix observed facts into takes; facts belong in 57 Ledger row or 59 Claim check.

Data it reads

FieldTypeRequiredNote
takes[]{heat: 1..5, text}yes1 Mild, 2 Medium, 3 Caliente, 4 Fuego, 5 Loco.

Access

  • The word names the level; the pips are aria-hidden, so a screen reader hears Caliente, not five dots.
  • No colour carries meaning here, so it reads the same in greyscale and in print.
